name: CS Odyssey: Zero to Hero 6-Month Mastery
description: An interactive, self-paced Computer Science & Systems learning platform for Grade 9 students and self-taught learners to achieve CS mastery in 6 months. Features the complete 12-stage student handbook, an interactive Linux & Bandit terminal simulator, live concept labs, 14 GitHub projects, a personal cloud notebook, and a Gemini-powered AI study mentor.
